name: Tokyo Weekend
desc: A 2-day sprint through Tokyo — Shibuya, Shinjuku, Asakusa, and Akihabara

stops.name: Haneda Airport (HND)
stops.note: Arriving Friday night, take Keikyu Line to Shinagawa

stops.name: Shibuya Excel Hotel Tokyu
stops.note: Connected to Shibuya Station, Mark City complex

stops.name: Shibuya Scramble Crossing
stops.note: Best viewed from Starbucks Tsutaya 2F or Magnet 7F rooftop

stops.name: Meiji Jingu
stops.note: Massive torii gates, free entry, closes at sunset. Buy an omamori (charm).

stops.name: Takeshita Street (Harajuku)
stops.note: Crepe stands, vintage shops, people watching

stops.name: Omotesando
stops.note: Tokyo's Champs-Élysées — architecture and high-end shopping

stops.name: Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden
stops.note: Greenhouse, French Formal Garden, Japanese Garden. Closes 5:30pm.

stops.name: Omoide Yokocho (Piss Alley)
stops.note: Tiny yakitori alleys, cash only at most stalls. Get there before 6pm for a seat.

stops.name: Golden Gai
stops.note: 200+ micro-bars, many with cover charge (~¥500-1000). Great for bar hopping.

stops.name: Sensō-ji
stops.note: Tokyo's oldest temple. Nakamise-dori shops open ~10am. Beat the crowds before 9am.

stops.name: Sumida River Walk
stops.addr: Sumida River Terrace, Taito City, Tokyo 111-0032
stops.note: Walk toward Skytree along the river, great photo angles

stops.name: Lunch in Asakusa
stops.note: Try unagi (eel) at Unatoto or tempura at Daikokuya

stops.name: Akihabara Electric Town
stops.note: Yodobashi Camera, Super Potato (retro games), arcades, anime shops

stops.name: Tonkatsu Marugo
stops.note: Legendary tonkatsu. Opens 11:30, line forms early.

stops.name: Haneda Airport (HND)
stops.note: 8pm flight, arrive by 6pm. Keikyu Line from Shinagawa.

routes.note: Keikyu Line to Shinagawa, transfer to JR Yamanote Line (counter-clockwise) to Shibuya
Walk through Miyashita Park for a rooftop detour
Exit Meiji Jingu via Harajuku gate, Takeshita Street is right there
Walk down Omotesando Ave, stop at Koffee Mameya for pour-over
Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line from Omotesando to Shinjuku-gyoemmae
Exit garden at Shinjuku gate, walk through the station area
Through the east side of Shinjuku station, past Kabukicho signs
JR Yamanote to Ueno, transfer to Tokyo Metro Ginza Line to Asakusa
Cross the street behind Sensō-ji to reach the river path
Tsukuba Express from Asakusa to Akihabara (2 stops)
JR Yamanote to Shinagawa, transfer to Keikyu Line to HND

days.note: West Tokyo — Shibuya, Harajuku, Omotesando, Shinjuku

items.txt: Grab breakfast at the hotel or a konbini (FamilyMart onigiri + Boss coffee)

opts.txt: Karaoke in Shinjuku — try a Kan Kan location for cheap all-you-can-drink

items.txt: Last Yamanote train ~12:50am — don't miss it back to Shibuya

days.note: East Tokyo — Asakusa, Akihabara, and depart

items.txt: Coffee at Fuglen Asakusa — a Scandinavian-Japanese hybrid in an old ryokan

opts.txt: Ramen at Kyushu Jangara Akihabara (famous tonkotsu)
